newsitem.title: UK: Momentum global sports fund up 66 pct in 1st 9-mo.
newsitem.headline: Momentum global sports fund up 66 pct in 1st 9-mo.

text.p: Momentum Premier Sports Partners, a global investment fund focusing on sports shares, has announced 66.08 percent growth in the nine months since its launch in May 1996, a statement from the Momentum Group said.

Momentum, which runs a range of 18 specialist hedge funds, said the dollar-denominated, Bermuda-based fund had tapped "substantial growth opportunities arising from the accelerating trend towards professional business management of sports clubs".

"The success of the fund is already encouraging imitations in the UK and internationally," said Michael Goldman, managing director of the Momentum Group. "We welcome all competition, which will inevitably boost prices as buying pressure increases in a comparatively thin market."
The other new players are thought to be a US sports fund and some warrants offered from London, plus a football fund expected to be launched on Thursday.
Goldman said the rarity of a number of sports shares had confirmed Momentum's diversified approach, with exposure to equipment manufacturers and suppliers, apparel manufacturers and sports clubs.
"This spread has created a range of investment opportunities which would not be available were we to search for a sector within an already narrow sector," he added.
The fund portfolio currently included Adidas, Arsenal debentures, Callaway Golf, Chelsea FC, Fila, Liverpool FC, Manchester City, Manchester United, Nike Inc. and Outboard Marine.
